Final results for the [[Tennis]] competition at the [[1920 Summer Olympics]] in [[Antwerp]], [[Belgium]]. The competition was held from Monday, 16 August 1920 to Tuesday, 24 August 1920.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.olympedia.org/games/7/sports/TEN |title=Tennis at the 1920 Summer Olympics |work=Olympedia |access-date=11 July 2020}}</ref>
